caption: The drawing features three columns, each containing five rectangular sections, with each section depicting a different embroidery stitch pattern. The patterns are composed of lines and shapes in red, green, blue, and yellow thread on an off-white background. In the first column, patterns include starburst shapes, zigzag lines, arrow-like motifs, and chevron arrangements, often combining more than one color per row. The second column contains geometric borders such as hexagon chains, radiating lines forming fans, crisscross arrangements, and parallel lines dotting the perimeter of shapes, also in multiple colors. The third column displays more angular, grid-like, and branching patterns, along with small floral or star motifs and symmetrical compositions, utilizing the same color palette. Each section is carefully bordered with faint pencil or ink lines, and the individual stitches are depicted with a clean, linear style that highlights their textile nature. The artist's name, “W. Wieckhoffel,” appears handwritten in the lower right corner.
title: Crazy Quilt
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
